coverage_manifest.label: ۷.۲.۱. ردیابی کامل زنجیرهٔ اعتبار در طول زمان
Reconstruct credit from original source through use, transfer, return/expiry; retain components, intermediaries, events and durable links
Split credit among recipients and combine sources without losing provenance or creating withdrawal rights
Section 6.5.2 component model and 7.4 identifiers; atomic shares; access/retention/history/testing; graph tech remains open
۷.۳. وضعیت خدمت، بانک و ثبت مالی چگونه از هم جدا شوند؟
Keep three related but independent service, bank-operation and ledger-entry lifecycles; technical names and transition table open
Pending entries may change with history; posted entries immutable; corrections/reversals new linked events; archive does not reverse posted entry
Unknown external cost keeps associated reserve until obligation resolved; later bank reversal is independent event
MT transaction states source; three-lifecycle separation is Shahab-approved model
Unknown top-up/withdrawal handling and unresolved service-cancellation obligation amount
۷.۴. چگونه تمام ثبت‌های یک عملیات به هم متصل شوند؟
Independent linked identifiers for operation, wallet, ledger transaction, credit component, reservation, bank reference, inbound event and correction
Operations may have multiple financial entries; corrections link to original; invoice ID cannot replace payment/operation ID; identifier format and uniqueness open
Associate processing amount, valid rate, calculation coefficient and operation-level reservation/capture/release identifiers
Ledger object/external ID references; correlation ID alone is not idempotency/uniqueness
Receipt/history, reconciliation, correction and duplicate control use identifiers
۷.۵. درخواست و پیام تکراری چگونه فقط یک اثر مالی داشته باشند؟

Multi-layer idempotency: per-action key, durable internal financial-event uniqueness and inbound duplicate-message detection; distinct action keys; altered input under same key cannot silently create new action
Persist processed event ID and financial effect independent of provider cache; cache expiry cannot remove financial uniqueness
Delayed duplicate bank success notification does not recharge; real reversal is a new linked event
Provider 24-hour key scope does not replace durable internal uniqueness; webhook processing guidance
Top-up, withdrawal/correction and recovery flows all obey idempotency
۷.۶. رزرو چگونه به مصرف قطعی یا آزادسازی تبدیل شود؟
Reservation linked to operation and exact credit components; capture may be partial; retain reserve pending outcome; release uncommitted balance after outcome; capture and reserve reduction atomic
Partial captures and remaining reserve; numeric figures are illustrative only
Partial post API reference does not imply arbitrary accounts or automatic Shahab component allocation
Reservation policies approved elsewhere; service numeric parameters open; release is not refund of captured use
۷.۷. چگونه جلوی مصرف هم‌زمان یک اعتبار گرفته شود؟

Condition financial effect on valid account/component version; no unprotected check-then-use; check withdrawal right, expiry, allowed service, component shares, reserves, employee/org caps, membership/list and pending operation capacity at commit boundary
Concurrent requests cannot both consume same balance or exceed employee cap
Balance lock does not by itself enforce campaign or org permission; preserve change history; DB/API coordination remains design work
۸. چگونه خطا، اختلاف با بانک و دسترسی غیرمجاز را مدیریت کنیم؟
Internal ledger must reconcile with cash, remain traceable and recover without duplicate effects; Shahab operations and customer org admin are distinct roles
۸.۱. تطبیق و رسیدگی به مغایرت
At-least-daily automated reconciliation; unresolved cases assigned to Shahab financial operations; every correction linked with reason and actor
Bank funds without matching top-up creates case linked to receipt/request
MT reconciliation reference; case workflow is Shahab policy
Funding/identifiers basis; SLA and operational authority limits open
۸.۱.۱. برش زمانی و پوشش تعهد
Daily cut has explicit time/timezone; gift and in-transit funds separated; open items reported; obligation coverage formula needs specialist approval
In-transit timing difference distinguished from unexplained shortfall
MT balance timing reference does not determine Shahab accounting formula
Source types/account model; exact cut time and formula open
۸.۲. احراز عملیات حساس
Reauthenticate withdrawals, bank-account changes, admin changes and material financial permission changes; risk controls for other operations; no required second approver
Admin reauthenticates before bank account change; second manager signature not required
MT roles reference; named sensitive actions are Shahab policy
Auth method and definition of material permission open; admin/account ownership elsewhere
۸.۲.۱. نگهداری دائمی و دسترسی سوابق مالی

Keep all personal/legal-entity financial events and provenance/transfer links permanently; attach supporting documents; separate nonfinancial technical/admin logs; preserve financially material admin trail; never store password/OTP; restrict record access and audit it
Membership removal/account closure does not erase financial history; transient server-performance log need not be permanent
Ledger/lineage and former-member receipt access; backup/migration/recovery and long-term protection open
۸.۲.۲. هشدارهای عملیاتی و امنیتی
Immediate alerts for coverage shortfall, material discrepancy, long-running unknown transaction, suspicious access; low priority periodic report
Unknown transaction beyond approved threshold alerts response owner
Threshold, channel, owner and escalation path open; customer notifications distinct
۸.۲.۳. نسبت ردیابی با تکالیف مبارزه با پول‌شویی

Focus on traceability; no new independent systems for four named AML areas; existing org mechanisms are not legal certification; traceability does not replace applicable legal duties; OTP/Shahkar coverage for exceptions not assumed
Authorized specialist can extract trace; not automatic statutory report; customer org admin gets no general suspicious-case access
Submitted AML law is a review source, not evidence all current regulations/amendments reviewed
Specified legal provisions and current regulatory application require specialist review; lineage does not replace review
۸.۳. بازیابی کارهای ناتمام و نتیجهٔ نامعلوم

Check outcome then recover automatically with bounded safe retry; unresolved cases enter Shahab operations queue; do not assume prior failure; replay result is not new charge; new execution after completion/stop uses current rate
Query bank status before restarting payment with unknown response
MT webhook guidance; retry queue is Shahab product decision
Attempt count/interval/deadline/escalation open; customer-retry rule distinct
۹. قیمت خدمت، هزینهٔ تأمین‌کننده و تسویه چگونه از هم جدا می‌شوند؟
Service price differs from Shahab supplier cost; wallet capture differs from bank settlement
۹.۱. مدل داینامیک هزینهٔ مشاور و دستیار
Adviser cost varies with processing; assistant service has base tariff; define price update timing and protect running execution from mid-run changes
۹.۱.۱. مبنای محاسبهٔ مشاور و دستیار

Dynamic adviser charge by prompt count and processing; assistant cost equals base operation tariff plus half of related in-operation adviser cost; one-third not current; 20% margin is an increase cap, not fee/profit; capture only calculated receivable
Example demonstrates base plus half adviser component and cap; amounts are not approved commercial rates
MT cited for balance/revenue separation; pricing coefficients and margin are Shahab decisions, not MT-derived
Reservation, capture, display details; processing metric and per-unit rates remain deferred
